basic.title: Materials Attendant
basic.summary: Experienced customer service and warehouse operations professional with a strong background in materials handling, inventory support, and member care. Skilled in customer service, logistics coordination, warehouse operations, and team collaboration within fast-paced environments. Proven experience supporting large organizations including Walt Disney World, Peacock TV, and GolfNow. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Golf Enterprise Management with a Business Administration minor from the University of Wisconsin-Stout.
basic.address: 1073 S Hiawassee Rd Apt 1026 Orlando, FL 32835

experience.title: Materials Attendant
bullets: Manage materials handling and inventory support operations within a fast-paced entertainment and hospitality environment.
Coordinate stock movement, supply organization, and warehouse-related tasks to support operational efficiency.
Maintain accuracy in materials tracking and collaborate with team members to ensure timely distribution of supplies.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Provide customer support assistance for streaming platform users, resolving account, billing, and technical concerns.
Deliver high-quality customer experiences through effective communication and problem-solving skills.
Handle customer inquiries in a fast-paced support environment while maintaining service standards.

experience.company: GolfNow, a division of Golf Channel
experience.title: Member Care Team
bullets: Supported members with booking assistance, account management, and customer service inquiries.
Assisted customers with golf reservation issues and provided timely solutions to enhance customer satisfaction.
Collaborated with internal teams to improve member support processes and service quality.

experience.title: Warehouse Associate
bullets: Performed warehouse operations including inventory handling, stocking, and order fulfillment.
Maintained organization and efficiency in warehouse processes to support daily operations.
Worked collaboratively with team members to ensure timely movement and storage of materials.

education.field: Golf Enterprise Management and Business Administration Minor
